TaskFlow Todo App

1 Product Overview
TaskFlow is a secure full-stack web application for personal task management.

1.2 Product Summary
Users create accounts, log in, and manage private tasks and categories in SQLite.

3 Target Users
- Students
- Employees

4 User Roles

4.1 Regular User
Owns a private workspace.

7 User Registration
Passwords must be hashed and email addresses must be unique.

8 User Login
Valid credentials create an authenticated session.

10 Authentication and Authorization
Protected routes require an authenticated user.

10.2 Ownership Validation
The backend must not trust user IDs supplied by a client.
Every task and category lookup must include the authenticated user ID.

Entities
User: full_name (text max_length=100), email (email), password_hash (text)
Category: user (foreign key to User), name (text max_length=50), color (text optional)
Task: user (foreign key to User), category (foreign key to Category optional), title (text max_length=200), description (long text optional), status (choices: pending,in_progress,completed), priority (choices: low,medium,high,urgent), due_at (datetime optional), completed_at (datetime optional)

27 Authentication API

27.1 Register
POST /api/auth/register

27.2 Login
POST /api/auth/login

29 Task API

29.1 List Tasks
GET /api/tasks
Supports search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

29.3 Create Task
POST /api/tasks

29.4 Update Task
PATCH /api/tasks/:taskId

29.7 Delete Task
DELETE /api/tasks/:taskId

32 Frontend Pages
- Landing page
- Registration page
- Login page
- Dashboard
- Task details page
- Categories management page
- User profile page

37 Security Requirements
No user may view, modify, or delete another user's records.

38 SQLite-Specific Requirements
All persistent data must remain available after an application restart.

47 Testing Requirements
Automated tests must cover authentication, authorization, ownership, and task operations.

48 Acceptance Criteria
- Users can register, log in, and log out.
- Users can create, view, update, complete, reopen, and delete their own tasks.
- Tasks can be searched, filtered, sorted, and paginated.
- Persistent data is stored in SQLite.
